title: fix(thread): a matched thread mill verifies clean - the gouge laws read its major circle
body:
#1071: a Thread op's helix runs the thread depth H = 0.5413 x pitch past the declared hole, which is the thread's minor circle (what CAD draws of a tapped hole), by design (`machining2d::thread_mill`). The verify read that hole as a wall the cutter must keep `r` from, so every matched thread mill was blocked.

That covered the stock source too, which the issue thought was unaffected: the same thread from `SrcRef::Stock` had 52 gouges and 21 crossing pairs. `mill2d_c` never asserted the warnings, so no thread mill could post from any source.

Fork synced at v0.18.0, PROCESS_VERSION 29; merged with upstream main at 62a2c93a (head ea76d5df).

## What changed

Three laws convicted a matched thread, and each is fixed narrowly.

- **Law (b), the rim.** The Thread arm now moves each declared hole's rim out to the major circle (declared radius + H), after the region is built (`material_source::major_rims`). This covers every source and the area-controlled region. A loop that is the hole's minor rim (ours, or the model's own for a through hole) gives way to it; every other wall stays.
- **The containment solid law.** It read the model's minor wall, and the face the hole opens through, as part to keep. A new `sim::verify::thread_bore` (and `solid_hits_threaded`) excuses a hit only when both of these hold:
  - the facet is the thread's own material: the minor wall (near-vertical, every vertex on the declared circle within max(2 % r, 0.1 mm)), or a facet with a vertex on that circle lying wholly at or above the hole's entry (the mouth);
  - the swept cutter stays inside the major cylinder: the farther tip end's radius plus the atom's radius is at most the major radius plus the allowance.

  Floors, walls of another radius, other holes and any cut past the major circle still convict. `solid_hits` is unchanged: it calls the threaded form with no bores.

  **Since the review of f122474d:** the band only RECOGNISES the wall. The cap reads the hit facet's own radius about the axis (its nearest on-circle vertex) plus the thread depth plus the allowance, not the declared major circle. A hole declared wider than, or off the centre of, the model's hole by more than the allowance now convicts. `major_rims` likewise grows a through hole's major circle from the model's own rim loop when that stands nearer than the declared circle.
  **Since the review of 434a464a:** the wall is measured at the facet's (or rim loop's) nearest point to the axis, not its nearest vertex. A chord between two on-circle vertices dips inside the circle.
  - That nearest point must itself be on the band, so a D-bore's flat, a coarse polygon's side, or a step reaching inside the mouth is never the thread's material.
  - The wall stands at that point, credited at most `CHORD_CREDIT` (the sim's `DEV_TOL`, 0.01 mm) toward its nearest vertex. That is tessellation of a round hole: the STEP importer meshes at half of it.
  - `major_rims` reads the same way. It moved with `thread_bores` into `operation/thread_rims.rs`, so `material_source.rs` stays at main's 350 lines.
- **Law (a), crossings.** The retract runs the ride backwards at feed. The reversed arcs put their chord joints a last bit off their twins, and `proper_cross` excused a touch only at an exactly zero orientation. So each shared joint, and each collinear overlap, read as a crossing.

  Now chords that only touch (an endpoint within 1 nm of the other chord's line) are no crossing. A real crossing keeps every endpoint off the other line. This is the one change that reaches every operation's verify, so the whole batch tier was run (below). A parallel-only guard was tried first: it removed 5 of the 21 pairs, and the rest were the joint touches.
- Two functions now take eight arguments (`SolidIndex::hits`, `contain_into`). They carry `#[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)]` with a reason, as ten others in `sim` already do.
- Decision record: `docs/decisions/1071-thread-mill-rim.md`.

## How it was tested

New pinning tests:
- `crates/app/tests/thread_mill_rim.rs` (a 6 mm Tap-form thread mill, pitch 1, model-sourced unless named):
  - `a_matched_thread_mill_in_air_verifies_clean`: the issue's cavity fixture (#1073's block). Before the fix: 52 gouges and 21 crossing pairs.
  - `a_matched_thread_mill_in_a_drilled_hole_verifies_clean`: a block with a real r 5 blind hole, 96-gon. Before the fix: the gouges came back from the solid law at the wall and the mouth.
  - `a_stock_sourced_thread_mill_verifies_clean_too`.
  - `a_thread_whose_major_circle_reaches_a_wall_convicts`: the major circle is 0.24 mm into the cavity wall; the minor circle is clear of it.
  - `a_thread_declared_wider_than_the_models_hole_convicts`: the model drilled r 4.5, declared r 5.
  - `a_thread_taken_below_the_models_hole_floor_convicts`: floor declared at Z 9, model floor at Z 10.
  - `a_declared_hole_wider_than_the_models_by_a_hair_convicts` (review round): r 5.05 / 5.1 on r 5, r 15.25 on r 15, and a through hole. It failed on f122474d.
  - `a_declared_hole_off_the_models_centre_by_a_hair_convicts` (review round): centres 0.05 / 0.1 / 0.28 mm off, blind and through. It failed on f122474d.
  - `a_matched_thread_stays_clean_at_other_sizes_and_through` (review round): matched r 15, a matched through hole, and a 5 um off-centre declaration.
  - `a_flat_whose_corners_stand_on_the_circle_convicts` (third review): a D-bore (flat from (3, 4) to (-3, 4)), an octagon and a 16-gon on r 5, and a through octagon. The D-bore verified with no warning on 434a464a, which was checked.
  - `a_fine_polygon_bore_still_verifies_clean` (third review): 48 and 96 sides on r 5.
- `sim::verify::thread_bore` unit tests: `a_flat_between_on_circle_corners_is_not_the_wall`, `a_tessellated_round_wall_reads_its_circle_and_a_coarse_one_its_chord`, `a_step_reaching_inside_the_mouth_is_not_the_mouth`.
- `crates/sim/tests/crossing_retrace.rs`:
  - `a_helix_run_back_over_its_own_trace_is_no_crossing`: three ride/retrace shapes, all-pairs and bucketed. It fails with the touch guard removed, which was checked.
  - `a_real_crossing_still_reads_as_one_at_any_angle`: 90 degrees down to 0.001 rad.

Gates:
- On the head ea76d5df (the third review's fix, merged with upstream main 62a2c93a):
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-sim`: every binary green (lib 89).
  - app `thread_mill_rim` 11, `verify` 21 (2 ignored), `mill2d_c` 9, `solid_law` 4, `solid_law_goldens` 5, `golden_cl` 25, `drill_prior` 12, `verify_arc_reading` 7, `bore_entry` 3, `bore_facet_sagitta` 2, `coarse_contain` 1, `ladder_entry_height` 4: all pass.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Review round 2, on the head 434a464a (upstream main 0fc30b65 merged cleanly, plus `turning: None` in the `thread_mill()` fixture for main's new `Tool.turning`, e1fc569a):
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test thread_mill_rim`: 9 passed.
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --test crossing_retrace --test crossing_buckets`: 2 + 3 passed. `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib`: 86 passed.
  - `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test verify --test mill2d_c --test solid_law --test solid_law_goldens --test golden_cl --test drill_prior`: 21 (2 ignored) + 9 + 4 + 5 + 25 + 12 passed, 0 failed.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim -p camcraft-app --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.
- On the head d9b36d6a (the review fix, merged with upstream main c8a1bab1):
  - `cargo xtask gate batch`: geometry, cl, tools, sim, motion and ui green. The post step (`script_tormach_plasma`) and the app and clippy steps fail on main's own breaks, #1146: stale recorded plasma refusals, and the missing `Cutter::neck` field in `rotary_law_tests.rs`, which stops the app lib tests from compiling. This PR touches neither.
  - Because of that, every app integration suite was run separately: `cargo test -p camcraft-app --test '*'`. Result: 297 suites, 2067 passed, 0 failed, 18 ignored.
  - `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` and `cargo clippy -p camcraft-app --lib --test '*' -- -D warnings`: clean.
- Before the review round:
  - `cargo xtask gate batch` on c770b35c (18.3 min): every test suite green.
  - geometry, cl, tools, post, sim (with `crossing_buckets`), motion (slow suites included), app (`center_cut_multiaxis` included), ui.
  - clippy failed only on the two eight-argument functions. With the `#[allow]` (head commit), `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.
- On the head, both pinning suites were rerun: green.
- No snapshot PNG touched.

## Not exercised

- No posted thread program was run on a machine or simulator.
- The thread flanks are not modelled: the whole minor-to-major annulus is read as removable (#986 owns the form).
- A tilted-frame (indexed) thread uses the same code path, but no test pins it.
- #1073's `coarse_rims::a_thread_mill_reads_the_same_near_the_bound_as_at_full_fidelity` lives on that open PR. When both land it can tighten to `== Vec::new()`, as #1071 asks.

Changelog: Thread milling: a thread mill matched to its hole verifies clean and can be posted. The gouge checks now read the thread's major circle, and the retract is no longer read as a crossing (#1071)

Effort: high (the issue's label). Not escalated.

Fixes #1071
